scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from the official Streets of New Capenna Magic Story episodes (2022-03-28 to 2022-04-05) and the Planeswalker's Guide to Streets of New Capenna. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.

entities.name: The five families of New Capenna

claims.subject: ob_nixilis

quotes.quote: Elspeth turned to see a hulking, horned man. Two wings of membrane, the color of old blood, stretched behind him. The Adversary.
"Good of you to show yourself, Ob Nixilis."

claims.summary: The crime lord known in New Capenna as the Adversary is Ob Nixilis.

claims.subject: giada

quotes.quote: Giada was their precious Font.
She was giving her life for the Cabaretti and their Halo.

claims.summary: The Cabaretti's secret 'Font' of unlimited Halo is the young woman Giada.

claims.subject: ob_nixilis

quotes.quote: Ob Nixilis snorted and spit on the mutilated body that lay at his feet.
The mighty head of the Maestros, the infamous Xander, master assassin. Not the master of anything now.

claims.summary: Ob Nixilis kills Xander, head of the Maestros, during the night of the Crescendo.

quotes.quote: Led by the demon-vampire Lord Xander, the Maestros are New Capenna's premier assassins, vampiric professional killers who see a contract not just as business but as a chance to perform.

claims.subject: anhelo

quotes.quote: The Maestros are now in your hands, and I trust that after the long night ahead, you will help them usher in a new era.

claims.summary: Xander's farewell letter passes leadership of the Maestros to Anhelo.

quotes.quote: Elspeth had made a promise that she would keep Giada safe until her last breath.

claims.subject: giada

quotes.quote: Giada thrust something to Elspeth's mouth, leaving her no choice but to swallow.
Invisible hands put her broken body back together, slowly restoring consciousness and clarity and shaking Erebos's grasp.

claims.summary: Giada heals the mortally wounded Elspeth with Halo during the Crescendo battle.

claims.subject: giada

quotes.quote: "Don't fear for me any longer, Elspeth. There is more for me out there—I am going to be with my family now."
Giada was framed by the shining outlines of others like her.

claims.summary: Giada transforms into Halo and departs with shining figures like her, implied to be New Capenna's angels.
claims.limitation: The text does not explicitly name Giada an angel; it shows her looking 'like the rest of the sculpted angels' and leaving with 'others like her'.

claims.subject: giada

quotes.quote: Light filled the room. It shot out in every direction from Giada's body, the force of the blast strong enough to throw Ob Nixilis away.
She looked on in awe as Giada was transformed into the radiant magic of Halo.

claims.summary: Giada transforms into radiant Halo, repelling Ob Nixilis.

claims.subject: elspeth_tirel

quotes.quote: Steel met flesh, and she grazed off the side of his neck.
In a blink, he was gone, having planeswalked away.
"Giada saved us all. But Ob Nixilis got away. This is far from over."

claims.summary: With the Halo-transformed sword, Elspeth wounds Ob Nixilis, who planeswalks away; he escapes rather than dies.

claims.subject: capenna_demon_lords

quotes.quote: In desperation, they formed an alliance with the Demon Lords.
The vast population of New Capenna had no knowledge of the archdemons' betrayal of the archangels and the five families' power grab.

The demons ultimately betrayed the angels, trapping them in a kind of stasis from which they could convert the angels' bodies into Halo, an essence that—as Xander had told her—could be taken to help protect the city.

claims.summary: Facing a Phyrexian invasion, Capenna's angels allied with the Demon Lords, who betrayed them and turned their bodies into Halo.

claims.subject: capenna_demon_lords

quotes.quote: In the distant past, the Phyrexians made an attempt on this plane.
The Demon Lords used Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappeared themselves.

claims.summary: According to the histories in Xander's archives, the Demon Lords used Halo to defeat a past Phyrexian invasion.

claims.subject: elspeth_tirel

quotes.quote: If it held the Phyrexians at bay here . . . this could be the answer Ajani sought, even if the supply of Halo was dwindling.
Elspeth would take it and all the information back to Ajani and the Gatewatch.

claims.summary: Elspeth takes Xander's hidden Halo cache and the histories back to Ajani and the Gatewatch as a possible weapon against Phyrexia.

claims.subject: vivien_reid

quotes.quote: Elspeth always considered herself a decent judge of character, and Vivien seemed trustworthy.
Elspeth and Vivien stood side by side, staring out the massive window in the same spot Xander had.

claims.summary: Vivien Reid allies with Elspeth in New Capenna.

claims.subject: elspeth_tirel

quotes.quote: She was relieved it hadn't been so long ago that she couldn't still track down her old friend in this mostly unfamiliar land.
"After defeating Bolas, I came here to meet with Karn and the Gatewatch to discuss the Phyrexian threat.

claims.summary: Returned from the Underworld, Elspeth reunites with Ajani on Dominaria, where he is meeting Karn and the Gatewatch about the Phyrexian threat.

claims.subject: capenna_demon_lords

quotes.quote: When they did, the demons appointed five families to take over the city in their name, drafting a pact with the head of each family."
The fragile alliances that fostered peace between the five families that ruled the city were being strained to a breaking point from which there would likely be no return.

claims.summary: The demons appointed five families to rule New Capenna in their name; by the story's start their alliances are near breaking.
claims.limitation: The appointment is told in character dialogue (Episode 3); the Planeswalker's Guide instead frames the families' rise as a 'power grab', so the mechanism is only implied.

remaining: Episodes 1-3 politics among the five families (Obscura, Riveteers, Brokers) are only lightly used
Urabrask's 'Revolution' message to Vivien is not graded
Old Capenna history in the Planeswalker's Guide (archangel-archdemon fortress) is only partly used
